planets.name: HATS-6 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HATS-6 with a 3.33-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: HATS-6 b was found in 2015 by HATSouth as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HATS-6. Its orbit and size follow Hartman et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
